finalText:
All 625 tests pass now.

The bug was in `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js:39-43`: tax was calculated on the pre-discount `cents` instead of the discounted amount, contradicting the function's own docstring ("discount has to come off the base before the rate is applied to it"). Changed `roundCents(cents * taxRate)` to `roundCents(discounted * taxRate)` — the only 3 failures (all "order totals" cases with nonzero discount and tax) now pass.
